**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 24 sits at the preferred position on every material term of the ASSIGN rule:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent, on prompt written notice only.
- **24.2** — Vendor is restricted asymmetrically in our favour: no assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent, and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.3** — Mutual "not unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed" standard for other assignments.
- **24.4** — Our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service; Vendor must cooperate with successor administrative changes.
- **13.3** — Licence rights travel with a permitted Section 24 assignment.

I also confirmed there is no deemed-assignment trap or change-of-control exit hidden elsewhere; the only other relevant provision (9.2 insolvency termination) is mutual and expressly excludes lawful reorganizations that do not impair performance.
